description: Jubilee Spinning & Weaving Mills Limited was incorporated in Pakistan on 12 December 1973 and obtained its certificate of commencement of business in January 1974. Its principal objective is the manufacture and sale of yarn and dealing in yarn and raw cotton, and it also operates electric power generation facilities that supply electricity within its production site. The mill is at B-28, Manghopir Road, S.I.T.E., Karachi, and the registered office is at 503-E, Johar Town, Lahore.
